intro: You are being interviewed for a job. Answer the questions confidently.

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Please sit down. Tell me a little about yourself.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Introduce yourself in one or two sentences.
expected: My name is Arjun and I finished school this year.
I am Arjun. I like working with people.
My name is Arjun and I am from Delhi.
conversation.hint: Try: "My name is Arjun and I finished school this year."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Why are you interested in this job?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Explain why you want this job.
expected: I am interested because I like helping customers.
Because I want to learn new skills.
I am interested in this work because it suits me.
conversation.hint: Try: "I am interested because I like helping customers."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: What would you say is your greatest strength?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what you are good at.
expected: I am good at working in a team.
My strength is that I work hard.
I am good at talking to people.
conversation.hint: Try: "I am good at working in a team."

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Do you have any experience of this kind of work?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Yes, I helped in my father's shop.
I have a little experience from school.

conversation.speaker: manager
conversation.text: Thank you. We will tell you our decision next week.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank her and say you look forward to hearing from her.
expected: Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.
Thank you very much for this chance.
conversation.hint: Try: "Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you."
